caption_L1: This is a line graph titled Gross domestic product (GDP) of Canada from 1960 to 2019 (in billion U.S. dollars). There is a linear scale of range 0 to 2,000 along the y-axis, labeled Gross domestic product in billion U.S. dollars. Along the x-axis, Year is shown.
caption_L2L3: The chart shows that there was a steady increase in GDP, year on year from 1960 up until around 2015. Around this time there was a slight decrease. The GDP figure dropped from its peak level of around 1800 billion dollars to approximately 1500 billion dollars. The level then began to steadily increase again after this dip.
